capabilities: Detect whether Obsidian is running on mobile or desktop
Set a separate theme for each platform
Switch between dark mode, light mode, or match device theme
Apply the platform-appropriate theme on startup or via command
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Automatically switch between different themes in Obsidian based on whether you're using it on mobile or desktop.
motivation: The author liked a theme on mobile but not on desktop and wanted both to apply automatically.
problem: Obsidian lets you set one theme per vault, so a theme that looks good on mobile cannot differ from the one on desktop.
summary: Theme switcher that automatically applies a different Obsidian theme and color mode depending on whether the vault is open on mobile or desktop.
